Starting a Phone run installs only Agen"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"t-scoped Phone tools and the dedicated Phone system prompt. Each `phone_act` performs a fresh pre-ac"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"tion capture, validates the strict action, resolves semantic element bounds, requests approval if ne"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"eded, executes through `PhoneDevice`, waits for a stable screen, captures again, verifies the result"},{"id":"p23s5","text":", and returns the new observation to the same Agent loop."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"The compact hierarchy removes invisible and meaningless containers, prioritizes text and interactive"},{"id":"p24s2","text":" nodes, assigns short IDs, and enforces element and serialized-byte limits. A `tap_element` action a"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"lso carries the observation ID. Before execution, the plugin revalidates the selected element's reso"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"urce ID, class, content description, and bounds; unrelated animation can continue, but a moved, miss"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"ing, changed, or ambiguous target is rejected as stale."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Security model"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- The model cannot issue arbitrary ADB shell text. Provider-owned diagnostic commands use a closed `"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"PhoneShellRequest` classification.
- Consequential semantic controls require the existing Harness ap"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"proval service when `approvalEnabled` is true.
- Unicode helper setup always requires the Harness ap"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"proval service, even when ordinary action approval is disabled.
- Approval is one-shot. A denied, un"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"available, or cancelled approval becomes a structured action failure.
- Raw coordinate actions canno"},{"id":"p26s6","text":"t always reveal their semantic effect. Review the visible target and use restrictive Harness permiss"},{"id":"p26s7","text":"ions when operating accounts, payment apps, or sensitive data.
- Device actions are real. Use a test"},{"id":"p26s8","text":" device and a non-production account during evaluation."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Report security issues according to SECURITY.md."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- UIAutomator can omit Canvas, game, image-only, and some WebView controls.
- Unicode text input req"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"uires a compatible external ADB Keyboard helper. Installed helpers are activated and restored transp"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"arently; installing a missing helper requires a reviewed APK at `adb.unicodeImeApkPath` and explicit"},{"id":"p29s4","text":" approval.
- Wireless ADB latency and reliability depend on the network and the current Android debu"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"gging port.
- Raw-coordinate actions cannot always be classified by semantic impact; use semantic el"},{"id":"p29s6","text":"ements and review approval prompts.
- The MVP refreshes screenshots after observations and actions; "},{"id":"p29s7","text":"it does not stream scrcpy video."}],"truncated":true}
